View all files Repository files navigation pbc — PocketBase Cloud CLI One tool run PocketBase locally, deploy PocketBase Cloud , and manage any PocketBase instance — from your terminal. pbc local init download PocketBase + scaffold here ./pocketbase serve run locally pbc login browser login pbc deploy detect kind, build, deploy; asks which project pbc logs pocketbase name app Works against any instance, not just the cloud: pbc admin login url https://instance.example.com pbc admin collections pbc admin records posts Keep several instances — several superusers one — once: pbc admin login url &;url&; name &;profile&; saves each, pbc admin profiles lists them (the active one starred), and pbc admin use name &;profile&; profile &;profile&; switches between them. pbc help lists everything. pbc &;command&; help explains one command. Install macOS/Linux: curl fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pocketbasecloud/cli/main/scripts/install. Pin version with PBC_VERSION=.. . Verifies SHA256, installs /usr/local/bin ( ~/.local/bin , override with PBC_INSTALL_DIR ). Windows, unzip the win32 zip from releases onto your PATH. npm installs ( @pocketbasecloud/cli ) are deprecated — reinstall once from the script above. From source: git clone https://github.com/pocketbasecloud/cli cli deno install deno.json pbc ./main. Deploy pbc deploy detects what the directory holds — PocketBase instance, frontend, backend — and runs the matching deploy. pbc init records the guess pbc.json without deploying; the first deploy directory writes its binding there, redeploys need flags: pbc deploy detect what this directory pbc frontend deploy name the kind outright pbc deploy env staging one directory, several environments The project picked runtime: the CLI asks which one use until the directory linked, and project &;&; answers without prompt. pbc environments lists what directory targets. pbc deploy help covers detection, build config, and the envpush flags. Scripting and export PBC_TOKEN=… portal → Account → CLI access token pbc whoami json preflight pbc frontend deploy input json pbc login token &;&; saves that same access token the local config instead exporting — handy headless box you' run several sessions . json prints one { , schemaVersion, dataerror } object stdout; progress goes stderr, piping safe. yes skips confirmations; input fails instead prompting. pbc init writes the GitHub workflow using pocketbasecloud/cli/action . Full reference: / docs . Old names still work , .json , and PB_ vars (pre..), plus pbc cloud … , pbc initinstallversionswhichupgrade , and bare collectionsrecordsrules… (pre..), all run and print the new spelling. New code should use pbc , pbc.json , PBC_ , pbc local … , pbc self upgrade , and pbc admin … . Platforms macOS/Linux (arm64, x64), Windows x64 (runs under emulation ARM). Anything else: install from source above. items.author: levmiseri
items.descZh: Liminal chess 是一种创新的国际象棋变体，旨在探索棋子在棋盘边界区域的特殊行为，为传统对弈引入空间与维度的过渡概念。其核心功能在于重新定义了棋子移动和攻击的规则，特别是在棋盘边缘时，棋子可以跨越边界进入“阈限空间”，实现非常规的战术组合。该变体最突出的亮点是引入了“阈限移动”机制，允许棋子在特定条件下穿越棋盘边缘，这使战术深度提升了约40%，并催生了全新的防守与进攻策略。它适合追求高策略复杂度、喜欢探索非传统棋局的国际象棋爱好者，以及希望将空间几何思维融入对弈的玩家。Liminal chess 不仅是对规则的修改，更是对棋盘空间本质的一次重新想象。

items.author: RitualDev
items.descZh: AgentShield 是一款专为自主 AI 代理、大语言模型（LLM）和 MCP 工具设计的企业级运行时安全防火墙与治理层，旨在阻止 `.env` 凭证、SSH 密钥泄露以及破坏性 shell 命令的执行。其核心功能包括实时数据防泄露（DLP）、零信任访问控制、审计日志记录，并默认提供零运行时依赖的 100% 本地气隙隔离保护。该工具的亮点在于其抗混淆命令防火墙和跨字节流的边界安全实时脱敏技术，在 10,000 次调用基准测试中实现了 P99 级别的极速脱敏性能（处理能力超 149k ops/sec），并支持秒级安装。此外，它提供多平台沙箱隔离机制（包括 macOS Seatbelt、Linux Landlock/bwrap 和 Windows AppContainer），并通过单一的 `ritual.policy.yaml` 声明式配置实现 AgentShield、DBShield 和 SkillPrism 的一体化堆栈引导。该方案主要适用于企业级开发环境，特别是需要集成 Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf 或 LangGraph 等自主智能体的工作流场景，确保 AI 运行过程中的核心数据安全。
